workflow: An owned isolated AutoCAD 24.3 process creates a native paper PViewport and model LINE, reads DisplayLocked plus VIEWCTR/VIEWSIZE/target/scale, locks the viewport, runs native ZOOM and -PAN and then MOVE in MODEL context, unlocks and repeats view navigation, relocks, saves and reopens an anonymous DWG.
result: DisplayLocked changed false to true without changing the camera; locked ZOOM and -PAN left view center 128.5,97.5, view height 1000 and scale 0.1 unchanged while MOVE changed the model LINE by exactly +100,+50. Unlocked ZOOM/PAN reached view center 400,200 and view height 500; relock and DWG reopen preserved the lock and camera. The owned PID terminated, zero acad.exe processes remained and no DWG, BAK or PID sidecar was retained.
